title: Trend Micro SafeSync for Enterprise check_nfs_server_status Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro SafeSync for Enterprise. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within check_nfs_server_status. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of root.
